thread:
kelly: Quick alignment — need an iteration for site hero + launch posts that feed the webinar funnel. Modes: Hosted, Dedicated, Private. CTAs: webinar signup and demo request. Who can mock hero variants by EOD?
ajay: I	can do two variants. Variant 1: cost-first ('Reduce unit cost, predictable latency'). Variant 2: reliability-first ('Production SLAs, global routing').
maria: I'll write microcopy per mode (12-15 words), and 6 short social snippets for X/LinkedIn/email subjects.
sam: Guardrail: no % claims in hero. Use 'reduce unit cost' — keep the 3x stat for benchmark + webinar. Confirm Dedicated mentions 'burst capacity' and Private mentions 'KMS/HSM'.
kelly: Good. Ajay, stash detailed numbers for webinar materials.
ajay: Routing plan: webinar CTA -> /signup?source=web_hero&variant=X, demo CTA -> /demo-request?source=hero. Add UTM params for tracking.
noah: Sales ops inbound payload suggestion (webhook): POST /webhook/lead with fields email, source, variant, interest, traffic_ts. Add header X-Route: sales or nurture to auto-split.
maria: Launch posts: open with a benchmark snapshot (e.g., 'Our benchmark shows 3x cost reduction vs baseline'), short customer use-case, CTA to webinar + full report. Social posts: one-line + link.
sam: I'll review benchmark copy/methods before anything goes live — need consistent model families, seq lengths, and visible noise bars.
calendar-bot: Webinar scheduled: "Inference Cost & Reliability: Benchmarks & Best Practices" — Wed 11/10 10:00 PT. RSVP: https://cal.example.com/r/ri-webinar-1110
ajay: A/B matrix for site: headline (cost vs reliability) x CTA (webinar vs demo). 50/50 split for two weeks, then choose winner for launch amplification.
maria: Deliverables: 3 hero blurbs, 6 social snippets, one long webinar landing paragraph.
noah: Lead routing rule for Ops: if interest == demo -> assign owner = SDR-inbound-demo; else -> nurture_sequence = webinar_followup_v1.
kelly: EOD owners: ajay (hero mockups), maria (copy + socials), sam (benchmark sign-off), noah (webhook + routing). I'll compile and add a Figma link when ready. https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder
ajay: Posting variants now. :rocket:
